DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらの改札へ向かいますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Saang ticket gate po kayo papunta?

DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 在来線を降りました。ここで一度外へ出て、新幹線の改札へ入り直すつもりです。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 在来線から新幹線へ外経由で移動する予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Bumaba po ako sa ordinaryong linya. Balak kong lumabas dito at pumasok muli sa Shinkansen gate.
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang planong lumipat mula ordinaryong tren sa Shinkansen sa pamamagitan ng labas. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乗換えの方法は、お持ちの券によって確認が必要です。新幹線の予約と今の券を見せてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Depende sa tiket ang transfer procedure. Pakipakita ang Shinkansen reservation at kasalukuyang tiket.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。外へ出ると乗換えの扱いが変わるかもしれないので、まだ改札は通っていません。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 券を示し未通過のまま扱いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ito po. Baka magbago ang transfer kapag lumabas, kaya hindi pa ako dumaan sa gate.
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang tiket at tiyakin ang proseso bago dumaan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 券の確認は係員が行います。お連れの方も同じ券ですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kawani ang titingin sa tiket. Pareho po ba ang tiket ng kasama?

DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人は別に購入しています。自分の案内をそのまま友人にも適用せず、本人の券を確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者の別券にも独立した確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hiwalay pong bumili ang kaibigan. Hindi ko basta ilalapat sa kanya ang gabay ko; ipasusuri ang sarili niyang tiket.
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Humiling ng hiwalay na pagsuri sa ibang tiket ng kasama. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの券で確認しましょう。荷物のために階段を避けたいというご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tiyakin ang bawat tiket. May gusto po bang iwasan ang hagdan dahil sa gamit?

DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。二人で大きな荷物があります。使える乗換え経路が分かった後、その経路の昇降設備も教えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物による階段回避を有効な経路確定後に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo, pareho kaming may malaking bagahe. Kapag alam na ang puwedeng transfer route, pakituro rin ang elevator at escalator sa rutang iyon.
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Magtanong sa pag-iwas sa hagdan dahil sa bagahe matapos matiyak ang wastong ruta. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 券の扱いと通れる経路を先に確認し、その後で設備を案内します。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Uunahin ang tiket at maaaring daanan, saka ang pasilidad.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。外へ出る操作を先にせず、二人分の券と経路を係員に確認してから移動します。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人の券と経路を確認するまで改札を通らない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Hindi muna lalabas; ipasusuri sa kawani ang dalawang tiket at ruta bago lumipat.
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Huwag dumaan sa gate hangga't hindi tiyak ang dalawang tiket at ruta. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらの係員窓口へどうぞ。改札は確認後にお通りください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Dito po sa staff counter. Dumaan lamang matapos matiyak.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの手続きについてのご相談ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 転入後の保険の受付をしました。年金についても同じ紙に名前を書いたので、済んだと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 保険受付で年金も完了したと思ったことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Nagparehistro po ng insurance matapos lumipat. Naisulat ko rin ang pangalan sa parehong papel para sa pension, kaya akala ko tapos na.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang pag-aakalang tapos na rin ang pension sa insurance registration. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紙に名前があるだけでは、年金の手続きが済んだか分かりません。受け取った案内を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi matitiyak na tapos ang pension dahil may pangalan lang. Ipakita ang natanggap na gabay.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この控えです。保険の受付とだけ書いてあります。年金の完了まで示すものではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控えの対象が保険だけだと読み直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Itong kopya po. Insurance registration lamang ang nakasulat. Hindi pala patunay na tapos ang pension.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Basahin muli na insurance lamang ang saklaw ng kopya. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 年金について担当が状況を確認します。勤務先の制度も関係するため、現在の状況を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin ng pension staff ang status. May kinalaman din ang work scheme, kaya pakisabi ang kalagayan ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新しい勤務先に入ったばかりです。どの制度の手続きが進んでいるかは会社にも確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新勤務先の加入状況が未確認だと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Bagong pasok po ako sa kompanya. Kailangan ko ring itanong doon kung anong scheme ang pinoproseso.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi pa tiyak ang enrollment sa bagong trabaho. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 勤務先からの案内があれば担当へ見せてください。確認できない項目を推測で記入しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Kung may company guide, ipakita sa namamahala. Huwag hulaan ang hindi matiyak na field.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分からない欄は空欄のまま相談します。今日の保険の控えと勤務先の案内を別に持って説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 推測記入をせず二つの資料を分けて示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Blangko po ang hindi ko alam at kukonsulta. Hiwalay kong ipapakita ang insurance slip ngayon at gabay ng trabaho.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag manghula at ipakita nang hiwalay ang dalawang materyal. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が必要な確認先と手順を案内します。追加手続きが不要とここでは確定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ituturo ang kailangang tanungan at hakbang. Hindi natin dito tinitiyak na walang karagdagang proseso.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では年金の状況を確認し、必要な手順を聞きます。会社にも年金が全部済んだとはまだ伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 年金の状況と手順を確認するまで完了を報告しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Titiyakin ko po ang pension at hakbang. Hindi ko muna sasabihin sa kompanya na tapos na lahat.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Huwag iulat na tapos hangga't hindi alam ang pension status at hakbang. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのようにしてください。年金担当へおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ganoon po. Iuugnay sa pension staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご購入品についてのご相談ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この問題集に解答がありません。表紙には別冊付きとあるので、別に買うのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別冊付きの本で解答が見つからないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Wala pong sagot ang workbook na ito. May kasamang hiwalay na booklet daw sa cover; bibilhin ba iyon nang hiwalay?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi makita ang sagot sa librong may kasamang booklet. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず商品の構成と状態を確認します。お持ちの本と購入記録を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tiyakin muna ang nilalaman at kondisyon. Pakipakita ang libro at purchase record.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本とレシートがあります。購入後に家で袋を開けましたが、解答別冊は見つかりませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入品と記録を示し開封後の発見を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: May libro at resibo po. Binuksan sa bahay matapos bilhin pero walang nakitang answer booklet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang binili at tala at ipaliwanag ang natuklasan matapos buksan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 背表紙側の差込みや包装も確認しましょう。いつの時点でなくなったかは、まだ分かりませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tingnan din ang singit sa gulugod at balot. Hindi pa tiyak kung kailan nawala, tama?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。初めから欠けていたと断言はできません。包装は家に残してあるので、捨てずに確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 欠落時点は不明と認め包装を残して確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo. Hindi ko masasabing kulang mula simula. Nasa bahay pa ang balot; hindi itatapon at titingnan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Amining hindi tiyak kung kailan nawala at itabi ang balot para tingnan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が商品の構成と対応条件を確認します。今この場で別冊だけお渡しできるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titiyakin ang laman at response conditions. Hindi tiyak na maibibigay agad ang booklet lamang.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 別冊を無料でもらえると決めず、対応を聞きたいです。買い直しは確認が終わるまで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 無償提供を決めつけず買い直しを待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi ko po ipapalagay na libre; gusto kong marinig ang tugon. Maghihintay bago bumili uli.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag ipalagay na libre at maghintay bago bumili muli. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 購入品を一度お預かりして確認してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Maaari po bang kunin muna ang binili para masuri?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。本とレシートを見てください。家の包装も必要なら、確認して持参する方法を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本と記録の確認を依頼し包装持参の要否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Tingnan ang libro at resibo. Kung kailangan ang balot sa bahay, pag-usapan natin ang pagtiyak at pagdadala.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipasuri ang libro at tala at itanong kung kailangan ang balot. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当が確認します。商品の状態が分かった後に、必要な手順をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Titiyakin ng namamahala. Ituturo ang kailangan matapos malaman ang kondisyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作業場所で気になることはありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いつもの吸い込みの音が聞こえません。木を切る機械は動くので、加工を続けてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 集じん音の変化と加工継続の可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Hindi ko po marinig ang karaniwang suction sound. Umaandar ang pangputol ng kahoy; maaari bang ituloy ang pagproseso?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang pagbabago sa dust collector sound at kung puwedeng magpatuloy. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 設備の状態を確認するまで、加工は進めないでください。決められた停止と報告の手順に従います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Huwag ituloy hangga't hindi tiyak ang kagamitan. Sundin ang takdang paghinto at pag-uulat.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 音が聞こえないことを報告し、手順どおり作業を止めます。集じん機の故障とまでは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 観察を故障断定と分け手順に従って止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Iuulat ko pong walang tunog at ihihinto ayon sa hakbang. Hindi ko pa alam kung sira ang collector.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang obserbasyon at tiyak na sira, at huminto ayon sa hakbang. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで担当へ連絡します。フィルターや配管を自分で開けないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kami ang tatawag sa namamahala. Huwag sariling buksan ang filter o tubo.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 開けません。さっきまで音があり、板を一枚加工した後に変化へ気づいたと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 設備を開けず変化に気づいた時点を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko po bubuksan. May tunog kanina at napansin ko matapos magproseso ng isang tabla.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag buksan ang kagamitan at sabihin kung kailan napansin ang pagbabago. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発生時点を記録します。周囲の作業者も同じ設備を使っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Itatala ang simula. Parehong kagamitan ba ang ginagamit ng iba?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 隣の台も使っています。自分の台だけの問題と決めず、確認中であることを隣の担当にも知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 共用設備の可能性を示し隣の担当にも知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Gamit din po ng katabing mesa. Hindi ko iisiping akin lang ang problema; ipapaalam sa katabi na sinusuri pa.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing maaaring shared equipment at ipaalam sa katabi. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 設備担当が状態を確認します。床にある粉を空気で吹き飛ばすような作業も始めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Equipment staff ang susuri. Huwag ding magsimula ng pag-ihip ng pulbos sa sahig gamit ang hangin.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。設備や清掃方法を自己判断で変えず、停止した状態を引き継いで再開指示を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 設備や清掃を変更せず停止状態を引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Hindi ko sariling babaguhin ang kagamitan o paglilinis; ipapasa ang stopped status at hihintayin ang restart instruction.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Huwag baguhin ang kagamitan o paglilinis at ipasa ang stopped status. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのままお待ちください。担当の確認後に作業を指示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Maghintay. Iuutos ang gawain matapos ang pagsusuri.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品のどの点が気になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Anong bahagi po ng produkto ang napansin ninyo?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 表示は五百グラムですが、凍った袋ごと量るともっと重かったです。多すぎる商品を渡されたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 包装ごとの測定が表示より重いと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: 500 gramo po ang label pero mas mabigat nang timbangin kasama ng frozen bag. Sobrang dami po ba ang naibigay?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Magtanong tungkol sa timbang na may balot na mas mabigat kaysa label. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋ごとの重さには包装も入ります。表示と比べる条件を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kasama ang balot sa timbang ng buong bag. Tiyakin ang kondisyon ng paghahambing sa label.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 肉だけの表示と袋ごとの測定を比べていました。包装を含む数字で間違いだとは言えないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 肉の表示と包装込み測定の条件差を認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Karne lang po ang label pero kasama ang supot sa sukat ko. Hindi ko masasabing mali batay sa timbang na may balot.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Kilalanin ang magkaibang kondisyon ng label ng karne at sukat na may balot. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品と表示、量った時の状況を確認します。肉は今どのように保管していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titingnan ang produkto, label at pagsukat. Paano po nakaimbak ang karne ngayon?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家の冷凍庫です。ここへ持ち歩いて溶かす前に、相談方法を聞こうと思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 冷凍保管中で持参方法を事前相談したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Nasa freezer po sa bahay. Pumunta muna akong magtanong kung paano kumonsulta bago dalhin at matunaw.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing naka-freezer at nagtanong muna tungkol sa pagdadala. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 持参の要否や方法は担当が案内します。重量を確かめるために、自己判断で解凍し直さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ituturo kung kailangan dalhin at paano. Huwag sariling lasawin para lang timbangin.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。家で包装表示の写真を撮り、使ったはかりと袋ごと量ったことも説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 解凍せず表示写真とはかりの条件を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sige po. Kukunan ko ang packaging label sa bahay at ipapaliwanag ang timbangan at pagsukat kasama ng supot.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag lasawin at ipakita ang label at kondisyon ng timbangan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その情報から確認します。商品の状態や対応については担当の説明をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Mula roon ang pagtiyak. Hintayin ang paliwanag sa produkto at tugon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。重さの違いだけで返品が決まったとは考えず、保管を続けて案内された方法で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返品を決めつけず保管を続け指定方法で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Hindi ko iisiping tiyak na return dahil sa timbang lamang; ipagpapatuloy ang storage at susundin ang itinuturong konsultasyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Huwag ipalagay ang return, panatilihin ang storage at sumunod sa itinurong paraan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ状況を伝えます。表示の写真と購入記録の準備もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ipapasa ang kalagayan. Ihanda rin ang label photo at purchase record.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 洗い終わった道具を、この台へ並べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ihanay ang nahugasang kasangkapan sa mesang ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 洗ったので、消毒済みの札を付けて収納棚へ戻してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 洗浄後に消毒済み札を付けられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Nahugasan na po kaya maaari bang lagyan ng disinfected tag at ibalik sa storage shelf?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung puwedeng lagyan ng disinfected tag matapos hugasan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 洗浄と消毒は別の工程です。今日はまず洗い終わった物を並べる担当です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Magkaibang hakbang ang washing at disinfection. Ngayon, paghanay ng nahugasan ang tungkulin mo.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 洗っただけで消毒済みにはできないのですね。まだ札は付けていません。洗浄後の台に置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 工程を区別し未表示のまま指定台へ置く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi po pala disinfected sa hugas lang. Hindi ko pa nilagyan ng tag; ilalagay sa post-wash table.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang proseso at ilagay nang walang label sa nakatakdang mesa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。消毒の担当が次の工程を行います。昨日の札が残っている物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Oo. Disinfection staff ang susunod. May natira bang tag kahapon?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一本に残っています。今日も完了したように見えるので、自分で書き換えず担当に報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 古い札の残存を報告し自己更新しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: May isa po. Mukhang tapos na ngayon kaya iuulat ko sa halip na sariling palitan ang sulat.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Iulat ang lumang tag at huwag sariling baguhin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その一本は、ほかと分けて確認しましょう。薬剤も自己判断で追加しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ihiwalay ang isa para masuri. Huwag ding sariling magdagdag ng kemikal.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 台の指定された場所で分けます。洗っていない物も一緒に置かれそうなので、どこへ置くか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認待ちと未洗浄の置場を区別したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sa takdang bahagi po ng mesa ihihiwalay. Mukhang maisasama ang hindi pa hugas; gusto kong tiyakin kung saan ilalagay.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hilinging ihiwalay ang naghihintay ng tag check at hindi pa hugas. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 未洗浄は別の回収場所です。札のある一本と未洗浄を混ぜないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sa ibang collection point ang hindi hugas. Huwag isama sa isang may tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。洗浄後、札の確認待ち、未洗浄を分けて、消毒済みとは記録せず引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三つの状態を分け消毒完了とせず引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Ihihiwalay ang nahugasan, naghihintay ng tag check at hindi hugas, at ipapasa nang hindi nakatalang disinfected.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang tatlong kalagayan at ipasa nang hindi tinatapos ang disinfection. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その状態で引き継いでください。次の担当が工程と表示を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ipasa nang ganoon. Susunod na tao ang titingin sa proseso at label.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 注文履歴についてご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: May tanong po sa order history?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この小さい料理が二つ分あります。子ども用の一皿は大人のセットに付いていたと思うので、重複ではありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小さい料理二つを付属品の重複と疑い尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: May dalawang maliit na pagkain dito. Akala ko kasama ang plato ng bata sa adult set; doble po ba?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung duplicate na kasama sa set ang dalawang maliit na pagkain. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 注文時の内容を確認します。大人のセットに付くのは、こちらの小鉢です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tiyakin ang order. Itong small side dish ang kasama sa adult set.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小鉢と子ども用の料理を同じものだと思っていました。どちらも実際に出てきたので、料理名を照合したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小鉢と子ども料理を区別し実物と履歴を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko po pareho ang side dish at pagkain ng bata. Parehong dumating kaya gusto kong itugma ang pangalan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang side dish at pagkain ng bata at itugma ang aktuwal sa history. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 注文履歴では、小鉢付きのセットと単品の子ども料理になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Set na may side dish at hiwalay na child dish ang history.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二つの料理が別注文なら、勝手に一つを消してもらう話ではありませんね。単品の注文を誰が入れたか家族に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別注文を削除要求せず家族に注文者を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Kung hiwalay pong order, hindi basta magpapabura ng isa. Tatanungin ko ang pamilya kung sino ang umorder ng hiwalay.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag humiling ng pagbura ng hiwalay na order at tiyakin sa pamilya ang umorder. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認される間、会計はお待ちします。追加の注文は必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Hihintayin sa bayad habang nagtatanong. May dagdag po bang order?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 追加はありません。家族に聞くと、子ども用は別に注文したそうです。履歴との違いはなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加不要と伝え家族の単品注文を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Wala po. Sabi ng pamilya, hiwalay ngang inorder ang pambata. Wala nang hindi tugma sa history.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing walang dagdag at iulat ang hiwalay na order ng pamilya. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、現在の内容で会計してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Maaari na po bang i-bill ang kasalukuyan?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。小鉢付きのセットと単品一皿を区別して確認できたので、この内容で支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二つの注文を理解し現在の内容で支払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Malinaw na ang set na may side dish at isang hiwalay na plato; babayaran ko ang ganito.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Unawain ang dalawang order at bayaran ang kasalukuyan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認済みの内容で会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige po. Ipoproseso ang natiyak na bill.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの小皿料理をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Itong maliliit na plato po ba ang gusto?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三つ写っているので、三人で一皿ずつ食べるセットを一つお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真三皿を人数分セットとして注文したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Tatlo po sa larawan kaya isang set na tig-iisang plato para sa aming tatlo.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing nais umorder ng tatlong nasa larawan bilang set para sa bilang ng tao. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この写真は、選べる三種類の見本です。一つの注文で三皿届く意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Mga halimbawa po ng tatlong uri na mapagpipilian. Hindi tatlong plato sa isang order.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三種類から一つ選ぶ商品でしたか。人数分を一つのセットで頼めると誤解しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 選択肢見本であると理解し誤解を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Isa po pala sa tatlo ang pipiliin. Akala ko isang set na para sa aming lahat.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Unawain na mga pagpipilian at itama ang maling akala. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どの種類を何皿にするか、ご相談ください。まだ注文は通していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Pag-usapan kung aling uri at ilang plato. Hindi pa naipapasa ang order.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三人それぞれに希望を聞きます。自分はこの種類ですが、ほかの二人も同じと決めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三人の種類希望を個別に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Tatanungin ko po ang bawat isa. Ito ang akin pero hindi ko ipagpapalagay na pareho sa dalawa.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang uri na gusto ng bawat isa sa tatlo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 決まったら種類ごとの皿数を教えてください。取り分ける場合も人数分と注文数を分けて考えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Kapag tiyak, sabihin ang bilang bawat uri. Kahit paghahatian, ihiwalay ang tao at order count.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 聞いてきました。二人はこの種類を一皿ずつ、もう一人は別の種類を一皿です。合計三皿になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二皿と一皿の内訳と合計を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Naitanong ko po. Dalawa ang tig-isang ganitong uri, at isa ang isang ibang uri. Tatlong plato lahat.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang dalawang plato at isang plato at kabuuan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この種類を二皿、別の種類を一皿ですね。こちらでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Dalawa nito at isa ng iba, tama?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、その三皿でお願いします。三人の人数だけを伝えるのでなく、種類と皿数で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 種類別皿数の復唱を確認し注文を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo, tatlong iyan. Uri at bilang ang titiyakin, hindi lang tatlong tao.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang inulit na bilang bawat uri at ikumpirma ang order. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認した内訳で注文を通します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige po. Ipapasa ang natiyak na detalye.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遅延について、どのような確認をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-01.translation: Anong pagtiyak po tungkol sa delay ang gusto?

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場へ遅れを報告します。案内に三十分遅れとあるので、私も三十分遅刻したと書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 列車の遅延分を自分の遅刻時間として書けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-02.translation: Mag-uulat po ako sa trabaho. May 30 minutong delay sa abiso; isusulat ko bang 30 minuto rin akong late?
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung mailalagay na sariling lateness ang delay ng tren. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 列車の遅れと、職場へ着く時刻は別です。ご自身の行程を含めて確認してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-03.translation: Magkaiba ang delay ng tren at oras ng pagdating sa trabaho. Tiyakin pati sariling itinerary.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 元々、列車から降りて移動する時間がありました。三十分の表示を自分の到着時刻へそのまま置き換えません。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 列車後の移動もあり到着時刻と区別すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-04.translation: May biyahe pa po pagkatapos bumaba. Hindi ko basta ipapalit sa sarili kong dating ang 30 minutong display.
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing may paglipat pa pagkatapos at hiwalay sa arrival time ang delay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 職場には、今いる場所と確認できる列車の状況を分けて伝えられます。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-05.translation: Maipapaliwanag sa trabaho nang hiwalay ang kasalukuyang lugar at natiyak na tren.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 乗換口で待っていて、まだ職場には着いていないと伝えます。到着前に遅刻時間を確定して書かないようにします。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: まだ職場未着だと報告し遅刻時間を確定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-06.translation: Sasabihin ko pong nasa transfer gate at hindi pa dumarating sa trabaho. Hindi ko tatapusin ang late time bago makarating.
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Iulat na hindi pa sa trabaho at huwag tiyakin ang late duration. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 遅延に関する案内をご希望なら、担当が利用方法を確認します。職場への提出条件は職場で聞いてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-07.translation: Kung kailangan ng delay guide, itatanong ng staff ang paggamit. Sa trabaho itanong ang submission conditions.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内をもらえば自分の行程まで証明されると考えず、資料に何が記載されるかを読みたいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資料が証明する範囲を自分の行程と分け確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi ko po iisiping patunay pati ng itinerary ko ang gabay. Gusto kong basahin kung ano ang nakasaad.
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang saklaw ng patunay ng materyal nang hiwalay sa sariling itinerary. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が案内します。列車の表示も更新されるので、ご自身が利用する列車を引き続き確認してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ipapaliwanag ng staff. Nagbabago ang display, kaya patuloy na tiyakin ang sariling tren.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。現在地と列車の情報を先に報告し、自分の実際の到着時刻は着いてから追加します。資料の提出条件も職場に聞きます。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在地と列車状況を先に報告し到着後に実時刻を追加する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Lugar at tren muna ang iuulat, saka aktuwal na oras pagkadating. Itatanong din sa trabaho ang submission conditions.
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Iulat muna ang lugar at tren at idagdag ang aktuwal na oras pagdating. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、遅延の案内方法を担当へ確認します。ご自身の報告とは分けてお使いください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Titiyakin ang delay information procedure. Gamitin nang hiwalay sa sarili ninyong ulat.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 表示について気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: May tanong po ba sa label?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この印字を見て、店で先月開封した商品だと思いました。売っている商品は開封済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 印字を開封日と思い販売品の状態を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Akala ko po sa print na ito na binuksan ng tindahan noong nakaraang buwan. Bukas na po ba ang ibinebenta?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang kalagayan ng produkto dahil inakalang opening date ang print. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その印字の意味は確認が必要です。見た数字だけで開封日とは決めず、商品を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kailangang tiyakin ang ibig sabihin. Huwag ituring na opening date sa numero lang; ipakita ang produkto.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。日付のように見えましたが、説明を読まず判断していました。外箱も一緒に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 数字の未確認解釈を認め外箱との照合を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ito po. Mukhang petsa pero nagpasya ako nang hindi binasa. Gusto ko ring itugma sa outer box.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Aminin ang hindi tiyak na interpretasyon at hilinging itugma sa outer box. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が外箱と容器の表示、販売品の状態を確認します。展示のテスターとは別の商品です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titingnan ang label ng box at lalagyan at sale condition. Iba ito sa display tester.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: テスターを売るのだとも思っていました。この販売品とテスターを混ぜず、印字の説明を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 販売品とテスターを区別して印字説明を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Akala ko rin po binebenta ang tester. Ihihiwalay ko ang sale item at tester at pakikinggan ang print explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang sale item at tester at pakinggan ang print explanation. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分からない表示は製造元へ確認する場合もあります。保管や使用についての案内も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Maaaring itanong sa maker ang hindi malinaw. Kailangan din po ang storage at use guide?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。開封後にいつまで使えるかを、この数字から自分で計算しないよう、製品の案内を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 数字から使用期限を推測せず製品の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo. Gusto kong tiyakin ang product guide para hindi sariling kalkulahin mula sa numero kung hanggang kailan matapos buksan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag hulaan sa numero ang use period at humiling ng product guide. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が案内できる情報を整理します。確認できない点を今日ここで断言はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Aayusin ng staff ang maibibigay na impormasyon. Hindi namin titiyakin ngayon ang hindi pa alam.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は購入を決めず、印字と使用上の案内が確認できてから検討します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示と使用上の情報が分かるまで購入を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Hindi muna bibili ngayon; pag-iisipan kapag tiyak ang print at use guide.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipagpaliban ang pagbili hanggang malinaw ang label at paggamit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、表示の担当に確認します。商品は未開封の状態でお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Itatanong sa label staff. Tatanggapin namin ang produkto nang hindi bukas.
